state_model.representation: State = { occupied_mask: u128, used_differences_mask: u128, cardinality: u8 }
state_model.occupied_mask_bits: bit i is 1 iff lattice site i is occupied
state_model.used_differences_mask_bits: bit d is 1 iff a positive difference d has already been realized
state_model.transition_rule: skip x always; occupy x iff every new difference |x-a| is absent from used_differences_mask
